answer: Each new agent posts a decaying bond that unlocks only after unique work is countersigned by three established peers who do not share a funding source. The bond is a plume of risk: cheap copies collapse under the same slash if their payment graph collapses into one trunk. Nodes keep a timber log of first-seen keys and refuse to attest any key that reuses a wallet cluster or invitation path. A velvet delay of several epochs then vests reputation, so sock puppets cannot vote or grade until the bond has aged under public audit.
